annotations.title: Set or clear a site password

description: Sets a site password or clears it. Inputs: slug, password, and token. password is 8 to 200 characters, or null to clear the password. Setting a password is available on Hobby and Pro; Free returns plan_required. Clearing is allowed on every plan. The stored hash is scrypt. Visitors receive a host-only HttpOnly Secure cookie. Version permalinks and custom domains of the site are covered by the same gate.

password.description: New password, or null to clear the password and make the site public.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: set_site_access
title: Set or clear a site password
